LESSON: TWAHARA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: DEVOTIONAL ACTS
Topic 4.1: Twahara

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Twahara. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: when optional ghusl is Why should Muslims maintain ritual purity?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the reasons for performance of tayyamum as a pre- condition for swalah
2. identify situations for the performance of sunnah ghusl
3. demonstrate ways of purification of Hadath Asghar and Hadath Akbar to maintain ritual purity
4. appreciate maintenance of ritual purity as a condition for Ibadah. performed and make summary notes, • demonstrate the steps of performing tayamum

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: TWAHARA
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 6
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Twahara helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: TWAHARA
Study Twahara like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain the reasons for performance of tayyamum as a pre- condition for swalah

What this means
In this part you learn to explain the reasons for performance of tayyamum as a pre- condition for swalah. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain the reasons for performance of tayyamum as a pre- condition for swalah.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Twahara” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain the reasons for performance of tayyamum as a pre- condition for swalah. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Identify situations for the performance of sunnah ghusl

What this means

PART 4: Appreciate maintenance of ritual purity as a condition for Ibadah. performed and make summary notes, • demonstrate the steps of performing tayamum

3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Twahara is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Twahara” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: explain the reasons for performance of tayyamum as a pre- condition for swalah)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Twahara in your own words. (skill: identify situations for the performance of sunnah ghusl)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: demonstrate ways of purification of Hadath Asghar and Hadath Akbar to maintain ritual purity)

Example 4: Show how “Twahara” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: appreciate maintenance of ritual purity as a condition for Ibadah. performed and make summary notes, • demonstrate the steps of performing tayamum)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Twahara to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain the reasons for performance of tayyamum as a pre- condition for swalah.
3. Practise this skill: identify situations for the performance of sunnah ghusl.
4. Practise this skill: demonstrate ways of purification of Hadath Asghar and Hadath Akbar to maintain ritual purity.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Twahara from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Twahara: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 6 learner study Twahara?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Twahara means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain the reasons for performance of tayyamum as a pre- condition for swalah.
5. Be able to: identify situations for the performance of sunnah ghusl.
